Add absence_notice for parent absence notices

Parents need a short written notice of the days their child missed.
absence_notice builds one from a student and their marks, listing the
distinct absent days in order and the count.

It raises ValueError when any mark belongs to a different student or
when there are no absences, so a notice is never sent for the wrong
child or with nothing to say.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

after.tests/test_notices.py:
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice

ANA = Student("1", "Diaz", "Ana", "A")

def mark(day, status="absent", student_id="1"):
    return Mark(student_id, date(2026, 9, day), status)

class AbsenceNoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_names_count_and_ordered_dates(self):
        marks = [mark(10), mark(3), mark(4, "present")]
        text = absence_notice(ANA, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ana Diaz missed 2 days:", text)
        early = text.index("September 3, 2026")
        late = text.index("September 10, 2026")
        self.assertLess(early, late)
        self.assertNotIn("September 4", text)

    def test_single_day_is_singular(self):
        text = absence_notice(ANA, [mark(3)])
        self.assertIn("missed 1 day:", text)

    def test_excused_does_not_count(self):
        marks = [mark(3), mark(4, "excused")]
        text = absence_notice(ANA, marks)
        self.assertIn("missed 1 day:", text)

    def test_repeated_day_counts_once(self):
        text = absence_notice(ANA, [mark(3), mark(3)])
        self.assertIn("missed 1 day:", text)

    def test_other_students_marks_rejected(self):
        marks = [mark(3), mark(4, student_id="2")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(ANA, marks)

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(ANA, [mark(3, "present")])

    def test_no_marks_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(ANA, [])
